definition_zh: 弹跳；上下晃动；（支票）被退回
definition_en: to hit a surface and spring back up
scene: 球从墙上弹了回来。The ball bounced off the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 bounce 是「弹跳」（第 1 个义项：撞到表面后反弹回来）；句意是球从墙上弹了回来。

collocations.zh: 支票因余额不足被退回

derivatives.zh: 夜店保安；弹跳力强的人

senses.title: To spring back from a surface
senses.definition: to hit something and move away from it quickly
senses.example: The ball bounced off the wall.
senses.why: This is the core sense, from an old word for a heavy blow.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心义项，来自古时表示重击的词。

senses.title: To move up and down
senses.definition: to move up and down again and again
senses.example: The children bounced on the bed.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在床上蹦来蹦去。
senses.why: Anything springing on a soft surface repeats the same movement.
senses.whyCN: 柔软表面上的弹起会不断重复同一个动作。

senses.title: To be sent back unpaid
senses.definition: to be returned by a bank because there is no money
senses.definitionCN: 因账户无钱被银行退回
senses.example: His cheque bounced at the bank.
senses.exampleCN: 他的支票被银行退回了。
senses.why: A cheque that springs back to the payer is said to bounce.
senses.whyCN: 支票弹回付款人手里，就说它 bounce 了。

intro.en: Bounce first meant to beat or thump, and the springing sense came later.
intro.cn: bounce 最初意为击打，反弹义出现得较晚。

items.en: bunsen meant to beat or thump.
bounce meant to spring back from a surface.
a bounced cheque was returned unpaid.
items.cn: bounced cheque 指被退回的支票。

items.en: bounce covers springing, jumping and returns.
items.cn: 如今 bounce 兼指反弹、蹦跳与退回。

note.en: The look-alike group rhymes with bounce; the near-meaning group names springing movements.
note.cn: 形近组与 bounce 押韵；近义组是弹起的动作。

entries.definition: to bounce back after hitting something

normalIntro.en: Bounce is a ball that refuses to stay down.
normalIntro.cn: bounce 就是不肯停在地上的球。

normal.en: Bounce and bounced are the base and past forms.
normal.cn: 原形是 bounce，过去式是 bounced。

normal.en: A ball bounces off a wall.

normal.cn: bounce back 意为恢复过来。

normal.en: A bounced cheque has no money behind it.
normal.cn: 退票的支票背后没有钱。

abstract.en: See a tennis ball striking a wall.
See children jumping on a soft bed.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子们在软床上蹦跳。

abstract.en: See a cheque sliding back across a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象一张支票从柜台被推回来。

examples.en: The ball bounced off the wall.
The children bounced on the bed.
examples.cn: 孩子们在床上蹦来蹦去。

examples.en: His cheque bounced at the bank.
examples.cn: 他的支票被银行退回了。

dict_mnemonic.text: bounce 读起来像球落地的「蹦」声，声音一响，球就弹起来了。

root: bounce 源自中古英语 bunsen（击打），十六世纪指重击，十九世纪转为撞后弹回，二十世纪又指支票被退回。

sensesIntro.en: Springing off a surface, jumping up and down, and a cheque sent back.
sensesIntro.cn: 从表面弹开、上下蹦跳，以及支票被退回。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ball leaving a wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：撞墙后飞离的球。

intro.en: Bounce takes -er and -y to name a person and a quality.
intro.cn: bounce 加 -er 与 -y 可表示人与性质。

latinIntro.en: The base is Middle English; the items below share the idea of springing.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自中古英语，下面的词都围绕弹起。

items.meaning: a person who guards a club door
